about: What a bakery or cake maker may change in the Proof design. Protected: the scroll-run bake drawn from the side (bake.make loaf: mixed, proved in a basket, shaped and scored, baked in a glowing oven as the crust browns, cooled, cut to show the crumb; cake: mixed, baked in tins, stacked, iced, decorated with a drip and berries, sliced), today's bakes with sold-out stamps, the cake builder with its live drawing and price, the pick-up order with opening hours, layout, type and all interaction code. The bakery's own words, the bake, the board, bakes, cake options and hours come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

bake: make loaf (a bread bakery: mix, prove, shape and score, bake, cool, first slice) or cake (a cake maker: mix, bake, stack, ice, decorate, slice); the crust colour when done, the crumb or sponge colour and the filling colour.
board: four numbers shown beside the bake, each with a label, unit, start and end, the stages over which it moves (first and last, 0 to 5) and decimals (0 or 1).
stages: six steps in order for the bake, each a short name, a caption and a clock time.
today: up to eight of today's bakes with a price, how many are left (0 shows sold out) and a drawing (boule, tin, baguette, croissant, bun, slab); open says when the shop is open today.

cakes: up to four sizes (price, serves, tiers 1 or 2, days' notice), sponges and fillings with an extra cost and a colour, finishes (ice none, smooth, drip or flowers) with an extra cost. order.hours: Monday to Sunday; a day whose hours are the closed word can't be picked.
